title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: Warns that the reallocation or reshuffling of frozen appropriations to other programmes or objectives would signal to governments that were not compliant with EU values and their obligations to protect the EU’s financial interests that losses can be offset elsewhere; believes that the spirit of the Conditionality Regulation precludes any such transfer and therefore urges the Commission to reject any requests for transfer to other programmes or priorities under the same programme that would lead to a circumvention of measures under the Conditionality Regulation; requests that the Commission submit to Parliament the full text of any such transfer request so that democratic scrutiny can precede, not follow, the Commission decision; believes that funds suspended in accordance with the Conditionality Regulation or on account of non-fulfilment of horizontal enabling conditions should not be eligible for programme amendments or transfers;
